run_inflate_model_cli: run the CLI to inflate a spatial model checkpoint to temporal with --embedder unet --extractor sam_small
inflate_convs_unet_embedder_inplace: inflate 2D convolution weights to 3D in a UNet embedder state dict in-place
add_temporal_attention_into_sam_inplace: add temporal attention parameters into a SAM small image encoder state dict in-place
add_temporal_attention_into_convnext_inp: add temporal attention and temporal conv parameters into a ConvNeXt state dict in-place
run_inflate_model_convnext: run the CLI to inflate a spatial model checkpoint to temporal with --embedder unet --extractor convnext_tiny
